mechanism_narrative: A higher level of residential fixed investment (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, thus driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns through increased corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Rank IC for RSAFS level and 5-day returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows and reduces risk appetite, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and 60-day returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates an economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and triggering negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns due to risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO decline and UNRATE increase does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (low unemployment), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, reducing corporate profit margins and leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE < 4.0% and INDPRO decline are not negative in more than 60% of instances or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, thus driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns through increased construction sector activity.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST level and 5-day returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for UNRATE > 4.5% and 60-day returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates a stagflationary environment, reducing corporate margins and increasing risk aversion, thus producing negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO decline and CPIAUCSL increase does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced economic activity, triggering negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors adjust valuations for lower growth.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and INDPRO decline are not negative in more than 60% of instances or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.
